disclaimer: Point-in-time capability data from public AWS documentation. Re-probe every selected model and API path in the target account and region before implementation. The public model cards list GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 on bedrock-runtime through Geo or Global CRIS for Responses, Chat Completions, and Converse; neither has an in-Region runtime ID. Endpoint, API, model, and Region support can change independently.

strengths: Recommended endpoint for new OpenAI Responses integrations

constraints: Model/API support and CRIS IDs must be checked on the current public model card
